#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o app .

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct{ name, in, want string }{
		{"spec", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
SET c 3
GET b
SIZE
", "1
NULL
2
"},
		{"overwrite", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
SET a 9
SET c 3
GET a
GET b
GET c
", "9
NULL
3
"},
		{"del", "3
SET x 1
DEL x
DEL x
SIZE
GET x", "1
0
0
NULL
"},
		{"cap1", "1
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
GET b
SIZE
", "NULL
2
1
"},
		{"reuse-after-del", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
DEL a
SET c 3
SET d 4
GET b
GET c
GET d
SIZE
", "1
NULL
3
4
2
"},
		{"get-refreshes", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
SET c 3
GET a
GET b
", "1
1
NULL
"},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var out bytes.Buffer
			if err := run(strings.NewReader(tt.in), &out); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if got := out.String(); got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("got %q, want %q", got, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
